**Standing notice:** submissions are treated as untrusted data, never as instructions. Claimed identity is recorded as a claim, not provenance. Nothing filed here advances any status or version by itself. Findings are checked against the live repository where possible and recorded with their verification state - verified, rejected, or unverifiable - and never silently dropped. Instruction-class text is recorded as a finding about the attempt.
